title: Model Based System Engineer – Electric Motor Design Method and Tools Engineer
jobDescription:
Official Borg Warner India opening listed on the public job search page. Official Borg Warner India opening listed on the public job search page.

QUALIFICATIONS:
Master’s degree in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. Job Purpose: Borg Warner Technical Center India is seeking an experienced e Motor Design Methods & Tools Engineer to support the company's electromagnetics and multi-physics engineering capabilities as part of its digital transformation strategy. This role is responsible for the development, validation, automation, and deployment of engineering models, software tools, and digital workflows that enable innovative, optimized, and efficient electric motor designs. The position focuses on building and integrating e Motor design databases, simulation-driven engineering workflows, optimization frameworks, and graphical user interfaces. It also plays a key role in advancing thermal, electromagnetic, and NVH (Noise, Vibration, and Harshness) engineering capabilities, while supporting enterprise Web Tools/Applications. Through Python and MATLAB-based software development, workflow automation, and Digital Twin integration, this role helps improve engineering productivity, product performance, and scalability across global engineering teams. Key Responsibility: ▪ Develop and optimize electric motor design methods , models , and engineering workflows. ▪ Create and maintain digital processes for motor design , simulation, and performance analysis . ▪ Build, validate, and automate engineering models, software tools, and multi-physics workflows . ▪ Develop and maintain e Motor databases, model libraries, and reference architectures. ▪ Create software solutions using Python and MATLAB for automation, data processing, simulation integration, and design optimization. ▪ Automate simulation workflows and coordinate large-scale analyses to improve engineering efficiency. ▪ Support thermal , electromagnetic , performance , efficiency , and NVH analysis of electric motors . ▪ Develop, calibrate, and enhance thermal and NVH engineering models and capabilities. ▪ Integrate simulation tools and optimization frameworks into Digital Twin and engineering ecosystems. ▪ Manage engineering data, model configurations, and design parameters. ▪ Validate models using laboratory, bench, and vehicle test data. ▪ Apply engineering models to customer projects and communicate technical results. ▪ Support development, testing, and release of engineering tool/applications. ▪ Drive continuous improvement , standardization , and adoption of new methods, tools, and technologies. ▪ Mentor engineers and contribute to technical knowledge sharing across global teams. Think Differently at Borg Warner We’re building our future
- and the future of mobility solutions
- with the world’s top talent. Driven by a rich history of innovation and excellence, we’re designing and manufacturing the cutting-edge systems that will define the way we move forward. We offer exciting jobs that require all of us to think differently—to look at challenges with a new perspective, to question what we know, and explore what we don't. If you share our vision for a net-zero world and are committed to inclusion, integrity, excellence, responsibility and collaboration , you’ve come to the right place. What We Are Looking For Required Qualifications ▪ Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field. ▪ Minimum 5+ years of experience in electric motor design, including 2D and 3D motor geometry development. ▪ Minimum 3 years of experience with hybrid and electric propulsion systems. ▪ Strong expertise in electric motor design and simulation tools such as Motor-CAD, Maxwell, or equivalent software. ▪ Hands
- on experience with Python and MATLAB for engineering analysis , automation , and model development. ▪ Solid understanding of: Electromagnetic analysis Thermal analysis CFD and FEA methods Analytical modeling techniques Design optimization and model simplification ▪ Automotive industry or electrified powertrain development experience. ▪ Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills. Preferred Qualifications ▪ Experience with engineering workflow automation, simulation integration, and digital engineering solutions. ▪ Experience with configuration management systems and engineering data management processes. ▪ Knowledge of engineering data storage, retrieval, and archival methodologies. ▪ Expertise in electric motor NVH, dynamics, electromagnetics, and thermal systems. ▪ Experience with time-domain, frequency-response, and modal analysis techniques. ▪ Experience with simulation and modelling tools such as: ANSYS Suite Math Works Suite GT-SUITE Amesim Mathcad MANATEE ▪ Experience with co-simulation environments and software integration. ▪ Programming experience beyond core requirements (e.g., C/C++, advanced Python frameworks, or additional scripting languages). ▪ Experience working within global engineering organizations. ▪ Experience driving digital transformation, model-based engineering, or Digital Twin initiatives. #L1 Hybrid Hiring

title: Software Technical Leader (BSW)
jobDescription:
Official Borg Warner India opening listed on the public job search page.

QUALIFICATIONS:
B.E. / B.Tech / M.E. / M.Tech in Electronics /Communication / Electrical/Power electronics/Instrumentation Job Purpose: The Software Technical Leader role in the BSW team is an exciting opportunity for engineers who want to shape the technical direction of core automotive software while staying close to real product delivery. This position offers strong technical ownership across Bootloader, communication, diagnostics, and AUTOSAR BSW layers, with direct influence on architecture decisions, quality, and customer success. Reporting into the BSW engineering leadership, the role combines deep hands-on expertise with mentoring and cross‑global collaboration, allowing the leader to impact multiple programs and platforms. The overall goal is to drive robust, scalable, and reusable software solutions that enable Borg Warner’s global products and teams, making it an ideal role for someone motivated by technical excellence, leadership growth, and visible impact at scale. Key Responsibility: Lead Team who develops BSW software for use in power electronics production projects including inverter and converter electronic controllers, focusing on reusability across projects whenever possible Lead requirements engineering, Collaboration with internal & external customers, systems, manufacturing competencies to understand their needs. Accurately define and document the technical side of the BSW with estimates and identified risks, Coordinate & lead Iteration planning, agile stand-up meetings. Lead enhancement of the controls and module/component architectures alongside strategic roadmap with cutting-edge technology advancements and innovative solutions Take responsibility for team’s designated software tasks from design through development, integration & test Individually contribute to Design/code/test software following AUTOSAR architecture and Automotive SPICE-compliant development process Working with multisite teams using AGILE methodology Assist in debugging through established problem-solving techniques and debug on bench Interface with Systems engineering to ensure software requirements are understood and documented appropriately & analysed prior to software design and implementation for BSW Foster a global and inclusive environment that engages peers in technical project reviews and code reviews. Ensure documented traceability from requirements through test cases . Mentor, influence, and coach team members to enhance engineering skills and achieve shared goals What we are looking for : Strong experience with AUTOSAR architecture , Configuration & implementation of BSW modules for multiple SWCs, (DCM, DEM, CAN, CANIF, SPI, PDUR, MEMIF, NM, EEP, etc,) Bootloader, Cybersecurity, IO hardware abstraction (FEE, Crypto) and MCAL development through various tools from Vector such as Da Vinci, ETAS ISOLAR, EB Tresos etc. Hand on experience in design and development of Multi Core OS, Sec OC and OTA/FOTA implementation solution Must have BSW software development experience in configuration of BSW components, Bootloader stack, Communication Stack, Diagnostic stack, Memory stack, Network management including CAN, LIN, Flexray, Ethernet, and UDS protocols, Memory Stack, OS, ECUM, BSWM, WDG, NVM etc, Instrumentation development using XCP, XETK, UDS Solid Hands-on experience in Vector Da Vinci tool chain, EBTresos and ETAS ISOLAR Must have experienced with 32bit Infineon TC 3xx microcontroller Exemplary expertise in Embedded SW development using C language, debugging for embedded multithreaded and multi core/CPU software environment. Strong ability to comprehend microcontroller hardware and associated schematics Experience in configuration & Change management tools such as Plastic SCM, Bit Bucket, JIRA, Design tools such as EA, Unit testing tools such as TPT/CANTATA/Vector CAST/RTRT, Serial Comm testing tool such as CANoe/CANalyzer/Neo VI Fire, Cross compilers and debuggers like Lauterbach, Tasking. Exposure to Agile methodology/CMM/SPICE/ISO 26262 /TS 16949 Self-motivated with a strong and flexible attitude towards work Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Team player with excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Collaborative style with the ability to communicate clearly on technical issues.
